a: If you don't trash 1 [X Antibody] or [Chronicle] trait card from your hand, you can't use the part after "then" in this card's [Main] effect to place this card in the battle area.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [Main] effect without meeting the "by" condition?

Effect: [Main] By trashing 1 card with the [X Antibody] or [Chronicle] trait from your hand, ＜Draw 2＞. Then, place this card in the battle area.
・1 of your [Grademon] or Digimon with the [Chronicle] trait may digivolve into [Alphamon] or a level 6 or lower Digimon card with the [Chronicle] trait in the hand without paying the cost.
